name: Documentation Update
description: Update existing documentation to correct or extend it, with review and validation.
failureBehavior: Stop at the failed step, record a failure entry on the session, and require re-planning before continuing. No automatic retry.
memorySuggestionPolicy: Suggest a memory only if the update reveals a broader convention worth capturing; stays pending until approved.
auditPolicy: Record workflow-selected, agent-selected, knowledge-retrieved, approval-requested/approved, validation-run, and memory-suggested events.
